headline: Corrections sent to the owner (PR #188): order latency costs about nothing in R, and a data trap was found where dropping unparsable trade records silently keeps mostly losers.
bullets: Latency: decision to order is 24-79 s (the live poll builds orders in turn), order to fill ~2 s; entry slip ~half the spread; Generator's weak results are not a fill problem.
Data trap: trade metadata can carry a suffix after the JSON; naive parsing fails on 15-51% of trades and those are mostly winners. Guild and BDI scripts checked: safe. Checklist item 33.
FWDCAL now replays the spread quotes live actually saw; fresh rule-21 audit on 11-12..11-13.
NEWSMID one look and FAMC session 2 after the 11-12 close.
